fields.label: Location
fields.note: The search publishes only one location facet (India > Bangalore > SSIR, codes locationindia / locationindiabanga / locationindiabangassir); the adapter's site=semissir scope already fixes it.

fields.label: Employment type
fields.note: From the linked Workday postings; the search API has no employment facet.

notes: The India tab (site=semissir, category=workday, stage=live, pagetype=page) calls https://search.semiconductor.samsung.com/semi/insightfinder with q, sort, startno, pageno and num. Unfiltered it reports 26 SSIR postings; q=verification returned 7, so keyword search is server-side. Only a location facet is published (India/Bangalore/SSIR); department and employment type come from the Workday postings and are filtered locally.
